scope: Ensaios isolados do adendo; passed nao significa todos os requisitos visuais/runtime cumpridos. Ver pending.
completed_stage: Contatos por direcao -> E -> F -> B -> C; artefatos gerados e ensaiados
pending: Jogo nao integrado; teste multiplayer real, latencia/perda, terreno e blends arbitrarios pendentes.
Contato aprovado condicionado a proposta ik.lock_release_s=1/60; configuracao original 0.08 falhou. Agachado testado por FK, sem certificar IK agachado do runtime.
Armas reais: calibrar anchors, mira extrema, coice, obstrucao e transicoes. Palmas hip no terco inferior; arma inteira nesse terco nao certificada.
Camera agachada usa referencia horizontal -0.17523 m: integrador deve misturar deslocamento com a camera da capsula.
Pivot FK apresenta ate cerca de 4.24 mm de deriva: adaptar trava IK a trajetoria real. E mede pes/maos e obstaculos de referencia, nao toda a capsula.
Crouch permite sobreposicao adjacente ombro/peito ate 4 mm (medida 3.41 mm); gestos com bracos altos excedem altura da capsula.
Ragdoll mecanico tem limites amplos; nao e anatomico humano nem fisica deterministica entre clientes. Testar custo de memoria/CPU no jogo.

validacao_blender.json.scope: Structure, rigid weights, scales, fixed root, socket transforms, loops and GLB masks. Motion/physics gates in named reports.

validacao_importacao.json.scope: All imported names/durations, loop endpoints, scales/root and socket offsets at start/mid/end; detailed motion/physics in block reports.

validacao_tronco_giros.json.scope: Torso amplitudes and delays, model-space mean poses, turn curves and planted foot rotation. Contact speed is in dedicated 60Hz runtime report.

validacao_contato_proposta.json.scope: Runtime copiado; piso plano, 8 direcoes constantes; antes/depois IK; metricas de material e ankle/toe separadas

validacao_E.json.scope: Clipes E importados; limites e folga dos pes na beirada geometrica; sem gameplay

validacao_empunhadura.json.scope: 30 presets, reference camera level, exact rigid mesh surface intersections, full hand vertices in 80deg vertical 16:9; real weapons and aim extremes pending

validacao_F_importacao.json.scope: Imported upper clips composed on declared body reference; both wrist transforms, real-scale weapon offset and ADS centre. Dynamic aim/recoil/walls/network pending.

validacao_B.json.scope: Imported B, 60Hz, crouch variants over crouch base. Full arbitrary runtime blends pending.

validacao_B_geometria.json.scope: Exact convex SAT 60Hz. Adjacent shoulder shell contact <=4mm accepted: original Idle already overlaps 2.66mm at this mechanical joint. Actual overlaps remain reported. Head and opposite arm intersections remain forbidden.

validacao_C.json.scope: Imported C at 240Hz; all mesh floor clearance, fixed root, Idle ends, recovery contacts and actual Jolt settled joint comparison. Gameplay impulse trajectory remains external.

validacao_ragdoll_limites.json.scope: All current clips sampled 120Hz; quaternion swing/twist in declared cone axes. Nonadjacent physical boxes in rest and Idle at 60Hz.

validacao_D_dados.json.scope: Markers and grips from imported geometry; mechanical joint coverage and ragdoll remain block C.

teste_godot/resultado_relogio_rosto.json.scope: Two local controllers; identical seed and absolute time. No real network or multiplayer integration tested.

determinismo.json.scope: Pacote completo do adendo, Blender 3.5.1, duas pastas independentes, GLB byte a byte. Nao inclui .blend nem determinismo de rede/fisica.

validacao_midias.json.scope: 137 MP4s: duration, 60 fps, three 512x512 views; visual inspection is separate.
